reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the playbook's preferred position for NOSOLICIT is that no non-solicit bind the Customer; the absence of any solicitation/no-hire covenant satisfies that position, so no redline or counterparty comment is expected.

The cited paragraph (p0066) is an independent contractor/no-agency clause that imposes no hiring or solicitation restriction, and it is left textually unchanged in the rendered redline — consistent with a compliant finding.

The failed deterministic checks (duration ≤ 12 months, general-solicitation carve-out) are sub-checks that presuppose an existing non-solicit; with no such clause they are inapplicable heuristics rather than evidence of deviation.

Rationale is accurate and appropriately scoped as internal evidence, including a correctly stated fallback position should the counterparty later propose a non-solicit; no negotiation ask is raised, matching the tone/prefix expectations.
